fluff.overview: Conventional infantry within the DCMS serve as the foundation of planetary defense, providing the manpower essential to territorial control while freeing BattleMech and armored assets for offensive operations. Motorized infantry travel on light unarmored vehicles that allow them to cover ground faster than the foot platoons that make up the bulk of DCMS garrison forces. District regulars rely on motorized platoons for security patrols across large garrison zones, forward observation, and the rapid response that foot troops cannot provide when trouble arises between widely separated posts. Armed with infantry-scale gauss rifles that use magnetic acceleration to hurl projectiles at extreme velocities. The longest-ranged and hardest-hitting personal ballistic weapon available to conventional soldiers, though the weapons are expensive and maintenance-intensive enough that most commands reserve them for their best marksmen.
